dedupe_keys.name: ea owt east asia offshore wind turbine data set 2019 2025

description: EA-OWT is a georeferenced data set of offshore wind turbines in East Asian waters, mapped from satellite imagery for each year from 2019 to September 2025. It was published on figshare by Xinyue Hu. Annual layers are cumulative, and each turbine has an identifier, class, country, type, capacity, rotor diameter, the first year it can be seen in imagery, and coordinates; as of September 2025 it has 7,919 turbines, with capacity for almost all and type and rotor size for most, compiled from manufacturer, government, owner and assessment records. A validation folder gives 2,781 predictions against independently interpreted reference turbines, with precision and recall of 99.96% at a 200 metre matching radius. Coverage is East Asian seas at turbine level. Files are CSV and Shapefile layers in WGS 84 on figshare (version 7, 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the first-year field is an imagery-inferred appearance date, not a commissioning date, and some attributes are blank. Simulation uses are offshore wind capacity and grid planning and exposure of turbines to storms. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
name: EA-OWT - East Asia offshore wind turbine data set (2019-2025)
